<h1>golem-agent-skills</h1>

[`golem-agent-skills` brings agentic coding to `{golem}`.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

A collection of agent skills for agentic coding with `{golem}`, helping AI coding assistants build production-grade `{shiny}` applications the golem way.
